name: Deploy from the command line
covers: NetDeploy.exe deploy as a pipeline would run it: a mistake in the command, a deploy with a secret from the environment, and the deploy showing in the history

steps.say: Run NetDeploy.exe deploy Contoso.Orders-1.1.0.zip without saying which install, as a pipeline might by mistake
It changes nothing, ends with exit code ${mistake.code}, and says what is missing: ${mistake.first}

Deploy 1.1.0 to qa again from the command line: NetDeploy.exe deploy Contoso.Orders-1.1.0.zip --install qa --yes, with the payments API key in the NETDEPLOY_PaymentsApiKey environment variable, so it stays out of the command
It printed the deploy's log as it went, and ended with exit code ${deploy.code}.
Click Refresh, so NetDeploy reads the folder and its history again
HISTORY starts with the deploy the command line just made

steps.checkpoint: qa was deployed from the command line

checks.label: Without --install it stopped with exit code 2
The deploy ended with exit code 0
The API key never showed in what it printed
The deploy was added to the history

look: What the command printed is in the run's log, run.log, after OUTPUT: the log, then the log file's path at the end.
The newest deploy under HISTORY is by you, a minute ago.
